# TrustyIcon

`Media` · composition depth: `base`

Renders any Iconify icon, named in collection:icon form ('ph:house'). The library defaults to Phosphor regular ('ph:*'); browse names at https://icon-sets.iconify.design/. The icons the library's own components use are bundled and render offline; any other name is fetched from the Iconify API on first render. Give it a token size, or omit 'size' and it renders at 1em, tracking the surrounding text.

**Use it when**
- a glyph needs to appear on its own, outside any component that already takes an icon name.

**Don't use it for**
- an icon inside a component that has an icon prop (TrustyButton, TrustyToggle, TrustyTabs and friends): pass the name, don't nest one
- a clickable glyph: use TrustyButton with 'icon' and no label, paired with an aria-label
- status next to text: use TrustyBadge

```ts
import { TrustyIcon } from '@louislp/trusty-ui'
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | ``${string}:${string}`` | *required* | Iconify name in `collection:icon` form (`ph:house`). The names the library's own components use are bundled and render offline; any other is fetched from the Iconify API. |
| `size` | `"md" \| "sm" \| "lg" \| "xs"` | — | Fixed design-token size (styled via `[data-size]` in CSS). Omit to size at `1em`, so the icon tracks the font-size of surrounding text. |

## Examples in Storybook

- Bundled — An icon the library bundles: it renders with no network. Inherits `currentColor`.
- Iconify — Any other Iconify icon, via the same `name` prop: fetched from the Iconify API.
- Sizes — `size` picks a fixed design-token size, independent of surrounding text.
- Gallery — Icons are square and tint to the surrounding text colour.
